brief_zh: 196 名有精神障礙兼非自殺式自傷（NSSI）的病人，中國多間中心，隨機分入 13 週 DBT 技巧訓練組（n=97）或社交支援小組組（n=99）
主要結果為 NSSI 想法與行為頻率（Ottawa Self-Injury Inventory），另量度邊緣症狀、情緒調節、衝動、述情障礙、正念、心理韌性與情緒智力
DBT 技巧訓練組在減少 NSSI 行為頻率上顯著優於社交支援組；在邊緣症狀與多個心理功能範疇亦有較佳效果
兩組在 NSSI 想法、自殺意念與企圖、抑鬱方面皆有顯著減少，但組間無顯著差異
結果支持 13 週 DBT 技巧訓練是中國臨床環境下治療 NSSI 的有效方法
caution: 中國臨床樣本，結果未必適用其他地區；兩組在自殺意念、抑鬱等結果上無組間差異；摘要未提及長期追蹤。

ethics_flags.note: 參與者為有自傷行為的病人，臨床應用時須同時評估自殺風險與安全計劃，不能只教技巧。

posts.content: 期刊摘要：13 週 DBT 技巧訓練對非自殺式自傷的多中心隨機臨床試驗，含設計、樣本與主要結果。
posts.title: 期刊論文（DOI: 10.1017/s0033291726104553）

summary_en: Published online 28 May 2026 in Psychological Medicine. A multicentre randomised clinical trial in China evaluated 13 weeks of dialectical behavior therapy skills training (DBT-ST) against social support group therapy (SSGT) in 196 people with mental disorders and non-suicidal self-injury (DBT-ST n=97, SSGT n=99). DBT-ST was significantly more effective than SSGT in reducing the frequency of NSSI behaviours, and showed superior effects on borderline symptoms and multiple domains of psychological functioning, including emotion dysregulation, impulsivity, alexithymia, mindfulness, psychological resilience and emotional intelligence. Both groups showed significant reductions in NSSI thoughts, suicidal ideation and attempts, and depression, with no significant between-group differences on those outcomes.
